Name: Living Planetoid, Minor
Information:
**Living Planetoid**

A hungry juggernaut that drifts through the cosmos, devouring anything substantial enough to cross its path. These elementals often form from the remains of planets destroyed by the Cosmic Teardrop, imbuing life into the shards that remain. Alternatively, chunks of space debris that carry a connection to the Elemental Planes may accidentally bleed life into them, causing them to come alive, confused and hungry.

Information Sections.Text: I’ll admit to having nightmares about my own home, a hollowed out planet I stumbled upon, coming to life. Mostly because I do bring back increasingly supernatural trophies and one day one is bound to have unintended consequences.

traits.name: Gravity Horizon
traits.description:
The planetoid can adjust all gravity within 100 feet of it. At the start of each of its turns, it can choose to turn this area into regular gravity, a low-gravity environment, or a zero-gravity environment.

When a creature attempts to leave the area of the planetoid’s Gravity Horizon, it may force them to make a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are immediately pulled toward it by 50 feet plus their remaining movement, and cannot take any more movement until the end of their turn. If pulled into the air they are suspended in place until the start of their next turn, even if the area is not a low- or zero-gravity environment.

actions.name: Debris Strike
actions.description: The planetoid chooses up to three targets within 60 feet of itself, and hurls orbiting debris at them as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Planetary Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) force damage. If the attack exceeds the target’s armor class by 10 points or more, they are automatically grappled and restrained (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Molten Rain (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The planetoid fires molten material into its own orbit, forcing each creature within 30 feet of it (except the planetoid itself) to make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
